text:
Sam L: Hey all — first day and hit a weird provisioning snag. Got the Google invite but when I try to accept it fails with alias mismatch. My corporate email is sam.lin@redwoodinference.com but the invite was sent to sam@redwood.ai (partner alias). Also Okta keeps prompting me for device trust and gets stuck on the Apple Watch code entry loop. 1Password still says no seat. Who should I ping? :grimacing:

Priya (IT): Sorry Sam — that sounds like a provisioning alias mismatch + device-trust enroll flake. Can you drop the invite link here and confirm the exact email on your badge/profile? I can check the directory mapping and push an alias. Also try accepting the Google invite in an incognito window (sometimes the chrome profile picks the wrong account).

Sam L: Invite link: https://mail.google.com/a/redwoodinference.com/invite/abcdef — badge email is sam.lin@redwoodinference.com. Tried incognito, still says "account not eligible / alias mismatch".

Evan (oncall): @Priya I can flip the alias mapping in G Suite for him if you want me to. FWIW Okta device-trust loops often clear if you remove the device from the Okta profile and re-enroll the Passkey/Yubi or re-issue the push. Sam, can you confirm if you were using a YubiKey or Apple Watch/Passkey?

Sam L: Using Apple Watch + phone. I did the Okta verify push but it keeps asking for the watch code then says expired and loops.

Priya (IT): Thanks. I just looked — the invite was sent to the external alias (sam@redwood.ai) instead of the primary. I'm going to add sam@redwood.ai as an alternate email on the directory record and re-sync with G Suite. That should let the invite accept.

okta-bot: Created ticket INC-4592 for Okta device-trust reset for user sam.lin@redwoodinference.com — assigned to Evan.

Evan (oncall): OK I removed the stale device entry and re-sent the Okta enrollment link. Sam, you should get an email from Okta Verify to set up again — follow the "Set up mobile device" path, ignore Watch for now (enroll phone first).

Sam L: Got the Okta enrollment and re-enrolled on phone, phone push succeeded. Still getting Google invite error but different message now: "account already in use".

Priya (IT): That is progress. "Account already in use" typically means the alias exists but not linked to the workspace user. I'm merging the external alias now — should take 2–5 minutes to propagate. Also flagged People Ops to provision the 1Password seat once the directory merge completes.

Marta (People Ops): On it. Once Priya confirms the alias merge, I will add Sam to the 1Password team and to the engineering GDrive group. Expect invites within 10 minutes.

Sam L: Received 1Password invite! Yay. Also now can accept Google invite. Thanks everyone for the quick help :+1: :partyparrot:

Priya (IT): Great — let me know if you want me to attach the corporate alias permanently (so you can receive mail on both). Also if the Apple Watch still gives trouble later we can try re-enrolling it after phone works.

Sam L: Please attach both aliases, that would be helpful. Apple Watch seems fine now that phone is enrolled. All good for now. Thanks @Priya @Evan @Marta :smile:
